title: SheetAdoptedPayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `sheet_adopted` (AN-02a, rule R-sheet). It records the adopted baseline sheet of a life, once. The first adoption sets the baseline; a later different candidate is logged as a conflict and changes nothing. sheet_hash is the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the canonical sheet JSON. The sheet is the true innate sheet: it must reach only the Body role, never an agent or an agent-visible text.
